name: Aparthotel Buchauer.Tirol
beschreibung: The Aparthotel Buchauer.Tirol is classified in the hotel category and is located in Thiersee. The accommodation comprises apartments with a kitchenette and living area. The breakfast buffet provides regional products. A wellness area with sauna complements the offering. The quiet location on the edge of town offers a view of the mountain landscape. In the surrounding area, hiking and cycling trails are signposted; winter sports areas are nearby. The concept combines self-catering with hotel service. The accommodation is suitable for guests seeking this flexibility.
